new_page.title: Coquitlam Penthouses for Sale | Prices and Buildings
new_page.description: Search Coquitlam penthouses for sale. 42 sold over the past ten months at a median of $655,000, with prices by neighbourhood and the buildings that sell most.

faq.q: How much does a penthouse cost in Coquitlam?
faq.a: The 42 penthouses that closed between November 1, 2025 and August 31, 2026 had a median of $655,000, with the middle half between $506,250 and $848,000. All Coquitlam condos had a median of $615,000.

faq.q: How does a Coquitlam penthouse compare in price with other condos?
faq.a: A penthouse cost 7% more at the median, or $701 a square foot against $769 for all condos. Compare the floor area, the strata fee and the roof or terrace before you decide.

faq.q: How fast do Coquitlam penthouses sell?
faq.a: 36 days at a median, closing at 97.3% of list, with 7% over the list price.

faq.q: What counts as a penthouse in Coquitlam?
faq.a: 42 of the 724 Coquitlam condo sales carried Penthouse in the style field, most of them in Coquitlam West (15 sales). The listing agent enters that, so some top-floor homes are unmarked and a marked one is not always on the very top floor.

faq.q: Do Coquitlam penthouses have higher strata fees?
faq.a: The median strata fee was $501 a month for penthouses and $433 for all condos.

blocks.text: Draft for Jared’s approval. Sold figures come from Paragon closed sales to August 31, 2026, because the export is incomplete after that. The live search is not connected yet.

This search lists penthouses for sale in Coquitlam: top-floor condos that the listing marks as a penthouse. It covers Coquitlam Centre, Burquitlam, Maillardville and the Evergreen Line stations. Other condos, townhomes and houses are separate searches.

42 Coquitlam penthouses closed from November 1, 2025 to August 31, 2026, out of 724 condo sales in the same area and months. The median penthouse sold for $655,000, 7% more than the $615,000 median for all condos, in 36 days at a median.

About buying a top-floor home in Coquitlam

Coquitlam’s 2026 residential rate is $2.2756 per $1,000 of assessed value for the municipality, or $3.8520 with the other taxing authorities, and taxes fell due on July 2, 2026. The city is inside the Speculation and Vacancy Tax area.
Coquitlam adopted its Interim Official Community Plan, Bylaw No. 5511, on April 27, 2026.
Before you offer on a Coquitlam penthouse

items.t: The roof is the first big shared expense for a top floor, so ask when it was done and read what the depreciation report says comes next.
A top-floor unit is the first to show a roof leak, so ask for the claims history and the insurance deductible in writing.
Read the strata bylaws on roof access, barbecues and furniture. They differ from building to building and often limit what a terrace owner can do.
Check the sun and the sound on a second visit. Penthouses here took 36 days to sell, so a return trip at another hour is realistic.

Compare the building’s fee with the $501 a month median for Coquitlam penthouses and $433 for all condos. A fee well above that deserves a look at what it covers. The median Coquitlam penthouse sold was built in 2009.
